purpose: Repair exact Amber-to-OpenMM ligand parameter translation causing reproducible preparation failure for PDB 6DBK and add representative regression coverage. Equivalence is only to the retained Amber prmtop force field, not evidence of chemical-state correctness, physical binding accuracy, MD convergence, or universal ligand support.

data.representation_policy: Preserve native Amber atom ordering, connectivity, charges, bond/angle/dihedral parameters, exclusions and 1-4 scaling. Do not mutate ligand/protein chemistry, change protonation, replace torsions approximately, loosen tolerances, or discard molecules to pass conversion. Retain original failed artifacts. Bound heavy coordinates are evidence of source pose, not energetic relaxation.

validation.status: Implementation pending; root may now run focused diagnostics and fixed-converter checks.
validation.baseline: Retained ligand.prmtop loaded with OpenMM AmberPrmtopFile on Reference platform using NoCutoff and no constraints, compared to converted XML at identical coordinates.
predeclared_matrix: Reproduce retained 6DBK native-versus-existing XML failure, decompose by force category, inspect exact term assignments.
Fixed 6DBK conversion at bound pose and two deterministic 0.003 Å Cartesian perturbations; compare finite energies/forces at unchanged thresholds.
Check native and converted atom count/masses/charges, bonds/angles, torsion multiplicities and reversals, exclusions and 1-4 scales; target existing failure mechanism.

Broaden across retained independent real ligands and compact synthetic topologies: aromatic/heteroaromatic, amide, symmetric outer atoms, unequal improper terms, multi-term torsions, reversed Amber index encoding, charged ligand.
Negative control: a deliberately changed force constant/charge must still fail validation; unsupported terms remain explicit failures.

Run full complex 6DBK prep from preserved input through public worker/API, retaining all organic ligand copies and modified residue evidence. Confirm output parameterizes; do not claim simulation convergence.
Run pertinent backend tests and validate packaging/runtime source parity if distribution is rebuilt.

comparison.notes: Deterministic software equivalence check with predefined absolute error limits; no hypothesis testing, predictive ML benchmark, independent replica convergence claim or chemical accuracy comparison.

review_identity: Independent automated evidence-linked checklist informed by public writing. PatAgent is not Pat Walters, endorsed by him, or expert certification.
